Yet cost and manufacturability are still checked after the drawings are released, by hand and in spreadsheets, when every change is slow and expensive. description: Senior Zephyr RTOS / Embedded Systems Engineer Before You Apply This is a Full-Time Employment opportunity. We are not considering B2B, freelance, consulting, or independent-contractor arrangements for this position. This is a hands-on Zephyr RTOS platform-engineering role. We need an engineer who can work inside and around Zephyr itself — close to the MCU, BSP, drivers, interrupts, memory, timing, boot flow, and hardware. If your experience is primarily developing applications on top of an RTOS without hands-on experience with Zephyr internals, BSP/board bring-up, DeviceTree/Kconfig, device drivers, MCU architecture, or low-level hardware/software debugging , this role will not be the right match. About L4B Software L4B Software develops secure, reliable operating-system platforms for embedded, regulated, and long-lifecycle products. Our platforms include MediTUX OS (Embedded Linux), MedicDroid (Android/AOSP), and MediTUX-RT , our real-time operating-system platform for microcontroller-based systems. Our engineering processes operate within an ISO 13485-certified quality management system , with software lifecycle and risk-management processes aligned with IEC 62304 and ISO 14971 . About the Role We are looking for a Senior Zephyr RTOS / Embedded Systems Engineer to help build and evolve MediTUX-RT , L4B's real-time operating-system platform for embedded and medical-device applications. This is a Senior Individual Contributor role requiring substantial technical ownership. You will work directly with Zephyr, MCU platforms, BSPs, drivers, interrupts, memory, timing, boot processes, firmware, and hardware integration , while collaborating with embedded, Linux, cybersecurity, validation, and quality engineers. What You'll Do Develop, integrate, and maintain Zephyr RTOS-based embedded platforms . Work directly with Zephyr internals, kernel configuration, Kconfig, DeviceTree, west, and the Zephyr build system . Perform board bring-up and BSP development/integration for MCU-based hardware. Develop, integrate, and debug device drivers and hardware interfaces . Work with peripherals and buses including SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, GPIO, timers, ADC, PWM, and watchdogs . Debug issues involving interrupts, concurrency, synchronization, scheduling, memory, timing, and hardware interaction . Analyze and improve real-time behavior, determinism, latency, resource usage, and system reliability. Work with bootloaders, firmware updates, flash layouts, and device startup flows . Develop production-quality embedded C/C++ . Investigate complex problems using JTAG/SWD, GDB, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and hardware debugging tools . Develop automated tests and platform-level validation. Contribute to secure firmware design, including Secure Boot and secure update mechanisms where applicable. Build the systems and documentation that transfer knowledge and remove single points of failure, not just your own. What You'll Bring AI-native engineering practices. title: 3D Creature Artist
description: In this volunteer position we are looking for someone who specializes in creating 3D realistic Creatures (yet with fantastical and heraldic touches/details), which includes Mesh Sculpting, Texturing and Fur/Hair Card experience, for " The Lays of Althas: Sundered Order " (LoA:SO). These Creatures would be seem alongside realistic Human characters. Rigging and Skinning Experience with 3D Creatures is not required, but is certainly helpful. Communication is key to a smooth and efficient pipeline. You must be able to communicate clearly and effectively with other team-members and not be afraid to ask should any problems arise. We are an English-speaking team, so English fluency is a must. If you are comfortable with teaching, you may be called upon to aid the more junior members of the team in any relevant area. Other duties include following team policies (given through team orientation as upon acceptance to the team) as well as attending meetings through Slack (our instant message program that we use to communicate) Minimum Requirements: Creating realistic Creature meshes and textures Creating Fur sculpts using Hair Card and Alpha Planes Physically-based Rendering (PBR) experience for game sculpting required Previous experience working with low-poly/game-ready assets required Full Texturing ability (Diffuse, Normal, Displacement etc). Able to work effectively and accurately from pre-defined concept art and designs. Able to work with and provide constructive criticism and feedback. Communication and Team-collaboration skills. A passion for modeling and a dedication to creating AAA quality games. Required Software: Unreal Engine 4 ( 3D Modeling Software, be it 3DS Max, Maya, Blender or similar. Must have valid license for said software. Adobe Photoshop, GIMP, Substance Painter, Marmoset, 3D Coat, or similar for creating high-quality 2D Textures. Epoch Games is a volunteer-based, all-online, global game development team. We have no centrally-located headquarters and are unincorporated at this time. Most of the original founding members were modders developing the total conversion Middle Earth Roleplaying Project (MERP) mod for the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim: Epoch Games is developing The Lays of Althas: Sundered Order (LoA:SO). LoA:SO is an in-development indie open-world RPG set in an original fantasy world. The game is being developed using Epic Games' Unreal Engine 4 (UE4): more information about the game, please check out our IndieDb page: The address above is the address related to Epoch Games ' Incorporation, but is not related to the place of work. We are a fully-online team with no central headquarters at this time. Communication is mostly done via Slack (an instant messaging application) and Trello (an online project collaboration tool). Companies including Canva, Meta, Mistral AI, and NVIDIA rely on Buildkite to run builds, tests, and deployments on their infrastructure, ours, or both - giving them the speed, reliability, and flexibility to ship with confidence. About the Role As a Senior CSM at Buildkite, you'll be a senior individual contributor responsible for driving measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of Buildkite’s Enterprise customers. You are the customer’s strategic partner in value realization - accountable for the adoption of Buildkite, the outcomes the customer achieves with it and the long-term health of the partnership. You’ll co-own each account with an Account Executive. The AE drives the growth of the partnership and owns the commercial relationship. You own the value the customer gets from what they’ve already purchased. You’ll work alongside a Technical Account Manager, who leads technical advisory on the customer’s current solutions, while the AE partners with a Solutions Architect on what the customer is evaluating next. You and the AE both build relationships at every level of the customer’s organization, each at your own angle. You’ll join a small, senior team while Buildkite’s Customer Success function is maturing quickly and you’ll help shape the playbooks and operating model that come next. We are looking for someone who wants to improve the role, not just fill it. What You'll Do Strategic Account Leadership Post-Sale Ownership: Own the post-sale state of your named Enterprise accounts: health, adoption, retention and spotting expansion opportunities. You do this in partnership with your Account Executive, who owns the commercial side of the relationship. Value Realization: Drive measurable business outcomes from the Buildkite investment by aligning each account’s success plan to the customer’s core engineering and business goals. Account Team Partnership: Work as one account team with your AE, TAM and Solutions Architect. Bring in Product, Support and Engineering when the account needs them, so the customer experiences one cohesive Buildkite. Cadence Design: Determine when and how to engage each account based on the value it returns to the customer — right-sizing engagement so every interaction earns its place on the customer’s calendar. Operating Model Contribution: Help shape the playbooks, processes, and operating model of a maturing CS function — and mentor new team members as the team grows. Executive Influence and Customer Partnership Executive Engagement: Cultivate and maintain trusted relationships with customer C-suite, VP, Director, and program-owner stakeholders — including the executive sponsor accountable for the Buildkite investment. title: Humbly Confident Marketing Lead
description: Headquarters: Utah URL: https://www.chirocat.com/ About Us and Why We're Hiring We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients. The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in! We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us. That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us. What We're Looking For REQUIREMENTS For this role, you must: Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan) Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow) Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving! Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them.
